title: COWS score pour Opiate Withdrawal
formula: Addition des points sélectionnés ; comme ci-dessus.

how_to_use.why:
- Comme indiqué ci-dessus, il associe des composantes subjectives et objectives, ce qui limite la possibilité de réponses simulées.
- Il peut être administré de façon répétée afin de suivre l'évolution de la sévérité des symptômes de sevrage au fil du temps ou en réponse au traitement.
how_to_use.when:
- COWS may be used in both inpatient and outpatient settings:

 - During Detox: for the general monitoring of opiate withdrawal during opioid detoxification.
 - During Pain Treatment: for patients receiving opiates for the treatment of acute or chronic pain who may show subtle signs of opiate withdrawal.
 - In the ED & More: for patients requesting methadone for opiate withdrawal symptoms and their enrollment in methadone maintenance treatment has not been verified.
- COWS is most commonly used in buprenorphine induction, and is recommended specifically for this use.
how_to_use.pearls:
- The Clinical Opiate Withdrawal Score (COWS) limits possibility of feigned responses by combining subjective symptoms with objective signs. ([Wesson DR 2003](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/12924748))
- COWS was first published in a training manual for buprenorphine treatment.
- While commonly used for buprenorphine or buprenorphine/naloxone induction, it can also be useful in a variety of office, clinic and hospital settings. Examples include the assessment of acute opiate withdrawal during an opiate detoxification program, methadone maintenance treatment, and the treatment of chronic pain.
- The scale is designed to be used quickly (< 2 minutes) by clinicians.
- Be aware that the prescribing of buprenorphine and buprenorphine/naloxone in the context of opioid addiction treatment requires additional credentialing by the DEA.

next_steps.advice:
Utilisation du COWS dans le traitement d’induction par buprénorphine :

- La buprénorphine est un agoniste opiacé partiel qui peut précipiter un sevrage opiacé floride s’il est administré à un patient physiquement dépendant.
- Lors de l’induction par buprénorphine, il est important que le patient soit déjà en sevrage opiacé léger à modéré avant l’administration. Cela équivaudrait à un score COWS >5-6 (>10 préférable).
- Ce point est important, car sinon les patients présentent un *sevrage précipité*, une apparition rapide et intense de symptômes de sevrage déclenchée par le médicament.
- Il n’est pas fiable d’utiliser le « temps depuis la dernière consommation d’opioïdes », car les patients ne sont pas toujours sincères lorsqu’ils rapportent leur dernière consommation, et le métabolisme varie d’un patient à l’autre.
next_steps.critical_actions: Toujours envisager la possibilité de troubles de sevrage comorbides à l’alcool, aux benzodiazépines ou aux sédatifs-hypnotiques, qui peuvent être potentiellement mortels seuls ou en association.
next_steps.management:
- COWS can help set patient expectations prior to buprenorphine treatment, as they will likely experience a certain amount of discomfort.
- Opioid detoxification works best with adjunctive treatments such as psychotherapy and support groups.

evidence:
**[Original article](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/12924748)**

This article presents the COWS scale and discusses the rationale for its development. As described in detail above, the scale consists of an 11-item rating system that can be completed within two minutes by a trained observer and can track opioid withdrawal as differentiated from opioid toxicity through serial measurements. It was designed to be administered quickly and was intended to improve upon existing measurement tools.

**[Validation study](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC2774236/)**

This study validated the COWS in comparison to the validated Clinical Institute Narcotic Assessment (CINA) scale. It used a double-blind randomized design to compare opioid withdrawal symptoms for intramuscularly administered placebo vs. naloxone to 46 opioid-dependent participants. COWS and CINA scores during the naloxone challenge session were well correlated with Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.85 (p<0.001) while placebo was not associated with any significant elevation in either score. Additional evidence of concurrent validity was provided by comparing COWS with the self-reporting visual analog scale (VAS); COWS scores correlated well with peak VAS scores of bad drug effect (r=0.57, p<0.001) and feeling sick (r=0.57, p<0.001). Cronbach’s alpha for the COWS was 0.78, indicating good internal consistency (reliability).
more_info:
**Interprétation du score :**

- <5 - pas de sevrage actif
- 5-12 - sevrage léger
- 13-24 - sevrage modéré
- 25-36 - sevrage modérément sévère
- >36 - sevrage sévère

input_schema.name: pulse
input_schema.label: Fréquence du pouls au repos (BPM)
input_schema.tips: Mesurer la fréquence du pouls après que le patient est resté assis ou allongé pendant 1 minute

input_schema.name: sweat
input_schema.label: Sweating
input_schema.tips: Sweating not accounted for by room temperature or patient activity over the last 0.5 hours

options.label: Signalement subjectif de frissons ou de bouffées vasomotrices (flushing)
Rougeur (flush) ou moiteur observable du visage
Gouttes de sueur sur le front ou le visage
Reports difficulty sitting still, but is able pour do so
Changements de position fréquents ou mouvements parasites des jambes/bras
Unable pour sit still pour more than few seconds
Pupils pinned ou normal size pour room light
Pupils possibly larger than normal pour room light
Pupilles dilatées au point que seul le rebord de l’iris est visible

input_schema.name: bone
input_schema.label: Douleurs osseuses ou articulaires
input_schema.tips: Si le patient présentait déjà une douleur auparavant, seule la composante supplémentaire attribuée au sevrage aux opiacés est cotée.

options.label: patient reports severe diffuse aching de joints/ muscles
patient is rubbing joints ou muscles et is unable pour sit still because de discomfort

input_schema.name: noise
input_schema.label: Runny nose ou tearing
input_schema.tips: Not accounted for by cold symptoms or allergies

options.label: Nasal stuffiness ou unusually moist eyes
Nose constantly running ou tears streaming down cheeks
multiple episodes de vomissements ou diarrhea
Tremor can be felt, but not observed

Yawning three ou more times during évaluation

patient so irritable ou anxious that participation dans évaluation is difficult
